description: This script generates RedBoot configuration scripts based on specified kernel and root filesystem files, including options for addressing, sizing, and timing. It encapsulates the logic for computing memory offsets and creating the boot script file.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Parses a numerical input, interpreting hexadecimal if prefixed with 0x, otherwise converts to number.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a RedBoot boot script based on input files and configuration parameters, calculating memory offsets and sizes.
